# Mintlify — Style Reference

> Ruled ledger paper with a mint-green ink stamp. One serif headline over Inter at 14px, a white page boxed by 4%-black vertical rails, and mint rationed to live counters and the logo leaf.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Mintlify uses a docs-grade product language: the marketing page is typeset like the documentation it sells. The canvas is #ffffff, controls sit on #fefdfb, logo and bento tiles sink into #faf8f5, and the only inverted surface is the #08090a action fill. The chromatic budget is one hue, mint green, rationed to four places: the logo, decorative line art in the hero, #1fa77a14 tinted counter chips, and #0c8c5e digits. The saturated fills on customer story cards are borrowed from those customers, not owned by Mintlify. Typography runs almost entirely on Inter at 400 and 500. The workhorse is 14px weight 500 (60+ uses), and section heads sit at 36px 500 tracked to -0.02em. Hierarchy comes from size and a two-tone ink/gray split rather than from bold weights. A single serif, Arizona Flare at 50px tracked -2px, appears exactly once as the hero headline. Shapes stay sharp at 4px for controls and 6px for cards, and elevation is a 4%-black hairline rather than a shadow. The whole system reads as a well-kept reference manual rather than a launch campaign.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page canvas, nav bar fill and the 20 instances of reversed text on action fills — the neutral ground every hairline and tile is measured against. |
| Cream Surface | `#fefdfb` | `--color-cream-surface` | Secondary buttons, square carousel arrows and the floating assistant trigger (11 uses) — a warm half-step that marks pressable things without lifting them. |
| Linen Tile | `#faf8f5` | `--color-linen-tile` | Logo wall tiles, bento feature cards and mockup wells (14 uses, #f9f6f3 snapped in) — a recessed paper tone that contains rather than elevates. Do not use it as the page canvas. |
| Jet Action | `#08090a` | `--color-jet-action` | Get started, Contact sales, Read customer stories and For enterprises fills — the only inverted surface, so black alone means "go". |
| Ink | `#121715` | `--color-ink` | Headings, nav labels, FAQ questions and body emphasis (55 uses, the most frequent text color) — a green-black that echoes the mint without being chromatic. |
| Slate Caption | `#485450` | `--color-slate-caption` | Supporting paragraphs, telemetry labels, footer links and the pause control (35 uses) — the workhorse secondary voice, cool-green and readable at 14px. |
| Pewter Muted | `#717d79` | `--color-pewter-muted` | Second clause of split-tone section headings and de-emphasized hero copy (4 uses) — it lets one sentence carry two levels of hierarchy at a single weight. |
| Ash Whisper | `#969e9b` | `--color-ash-whisper` | Disabled carousel arrows, placeholder text and faded sidebar items in mockups (5 uses) — the floor of the text ladder. Do not set readable body copy in it. |
| Stone Rule | `#f1f0ee` | `--color-stone-rule` | FAQ dividers, product-mockup frame borders and footer separators (6 uses) — an opaque warm rule for places where translucency would double up. |
| Fog Hairline | `#0000000a` | `--color-fog-hairline` | Card borders, nav bottom rule, vertical page rails and telemetry strip edges (14 uses) — a 4%-black line that reads identically on white and on linen. |
| Smoke Ring | `#0000000f` | `--color-smoke-ring` | Borders on secondary buttons, icon buttons and the assistant trigger (4 uses) — 6% black, one notch firmer than cards so controls feel graspable. |
| Mint Wash | `#1fa77a14` | `--color-mint-wash` | Counter chips in the telemetry strip and the announcement chip (11 uses) — an 8% mint tint that turns numbers into a live readout. Do not promote it to a button fill. |
| Forest Ink | `#0c8c5e` | `--color-forest-ink` | Logo lower leaf, mono counter digits and the section-heading tick (estimated for digits) — the one saturated ink on the page, kept at small sizes so it reads as a signal. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Inter — the interface voice for every word except one headline · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter itself is free (use it at 400/500 unchanged). Geist at 400/500 matches the stroke. Hanken Grotesk at 450/550 compensates for its slightly lighter drawing. Avoid Manrope, which reads bolder at 500.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 16px, 18px, 24px, 32px, 36px, 44px
- **Line height:** 1.091, 1.111, 1.143, 1.167, 1.333, 1.429, 1.5, 1.714
- **Letter spacing:** +0.24px at 12px, -0.1px at 14px (selected labels), 0 at 16px and 18px, -0.24px at 24px, -0.64px at 32px, -0.72px at 36px, -0.88px at 44px
- **Role:** Weight 500 outnumbers 400 (143 against 109 uses), so this is an application UI wearing a marketing page, not the other way round. Headings stop at 500 where convention would reach for 600–700. Authority comes from tracking tightened to -0.02em at 36px and above. The 24→36 step is a Perfect Fifth (1.5), but 36→44 is only 1.22, so the top of the scale is compressed. Large type stays measured and never shouts.

### Paper Mono — the telemetry readout for live numbers · `--font-paper-mono`

- **Substitute:** JetBrains Mono at 500, Geist Mono at 500, IBM Plex Mono at 500. Paper Mono 500 draws close to nominal, so do not drop to 400.
- **Weights:** 500
- **Sizes:** 12px
- **Line height:** 1, 1.333
- **Letter spacing:** +0.24px at 12px
- **OpenType features:** `"ss03"`
- **Role:** Mono is confined to digits inside counters (14 uses at one size). That makes every number read as instrumented data rather than marketing copy. The +0.02em tracking and the ss03 stylistic set keep 77.3981% and 10,759,988 legible at 12px inside tinted chips.

### Arizona Flare — the single serif headline · `--font-arizona-flare`

- **Substitute:** Newsreader Display at 400, Source Serif 4 (display optical size) at 400, Fraunces at 350 with SOFT 0 and WONK 0. Arizona Flare draws slightly lighter than a book serif at 400, so Fraunces needs the step down.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 36px, 50px
- **Line height:** 1.04, 1.111
- **Letter spacing:** -2px at 50px, -0.72px at 36px
- **Role:** This flared serif appears twice in the whole DOM, and the hero h1 is its signature appearance. At -0.04em it locks into a dense, bookish block in a 352px column. Pairing a serif display with an Inter UI is the classic editorial move, and rationing the serif to one headline turns it into a byline.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 500 | 12px | 1.333 | 0.24px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Paper Mono | 500 | 12px | 1 | 0.24px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | — | 14px | 1.429 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 400 | 18px | 1.333 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| heading-sm | Inter | 500 | 24px | 1.167 | -0.24px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Inter | 500 | 36px | 1.111 | -0.72px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Inter | 400 | 44px | 1.091 | -0.88px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Arizona Flare | 400 | 50px | 1.04 | -2px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every control label, nav item and button in Inter 14px weight 500 — with 60+ uses it is the workhorse that makes the page feel like product chrome.
- Keep buttons and tags at 4px and cards at 6px — two adjacent radii separate "press" from "contain" without introducing a rounded vocabulary.
- Draw structure with 1px #0000000a hairlines, including the vertical rails on the 1088px column — translucent 4% black matches on #ffffff and #faf8f5 alike.
- Spend Arizona Flare once per page, at 50px weight 400 tracked -2px — the scarcity of the serif is what makes the hero read as authored. This rule is non-negotiable.
- Render every live number in Paper Mono 12px weight 500, +0.24px, ss03, on a #1fa77a14 chip with #0c8c5e digits — figures become instrument readings.
- Split section headings into a #121715 claim and a #717d79 continuation at 36px weight 500 — hierarchy through ink keeps the weight ceiling at 500.
- Cap heading measure at 664px and FAQ measure at 768px inside the 1088px rail — documentation line lengths are part of the voice.

### Don't

- Don't bump headings to weight 600 or 700 — this is a marketing page typeset like its own documentation, and bold display type turns the reference manual into an ad.
- Never fill a primary button with Forest Ink #0c8c5e — #08090a owns action, and a green CTA would compete with the logo and the telemetry chips.
- Don't round CTAs to 9999px — the pill radius exists only inside product mockups, and pill buttons would pull the system toward consumer-app softness.
- Don't add drop shadows to bento cards or logo tiles — the only shadow is a 2% inset ring, and a 0 8px 24px blur would float objects the system deliberately recesses.
- Don't extend Arizona Flare to the 36px section heads — two serif headlines dilute the single editorial gesture into a theme.
- Don't use #000000 for body text — #121715 carries a green undertone that keeps neutrals tied to the mint without adding a hue.
- Don't tint the page canvas to #faf8f5 — linen only reads as recessed against #ffffff, and flooding it erases the tile hierarchy.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- recessed tile: #faf8f5 (Linen Tile)
- primary text: #121715 (Ink)
- secondary text: #485450 (Slate Caption)
- hairline: #0000000a (Fog Hairline)
- accent tint: #1fa77a14 (Mint Wash)
- primary action: #08090a (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars use neutral fills in #121715 and #969e9b on #faf8f5. Mint appears only as a #1fa77a14 (8% opacity) tint behind values or as #0c8c5e for one highlighted series, so the accent stays at counter-chip volume.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: background #08090a, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 4px, padding 12px 12px 12px 16px, height 42px, Inter 14px weight 500, line-height 1.143, letter-spacing 0. Add a 12px right-chevron icon in #ffffff after the label with a 4px gap. Use no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and shift the chevron 2px right. Place it beside a secondary button with background #fefdfb, text #121715, a 1px solid #0000000f border, 4px radius, padding 12px 16px and the same 42px height, separated by an 8px gap.

2. Build a hero section: a #ffffff canvas with a 1088px container bounded by 1px #0000000a left and right borders. The left column is 352px wide. Stack a telemetry chip first: #ffffff fill, 1px #0000000a border, 4px radius, 4px 6px padding, label "Agent traffic" in Inter 12px weight 500 #485450 with 0.24px tracking, and a nested #1fa77a14 counter at 2px radius showing "77.3981%" in Paper Mono 12px weight 500 #0c8c5e with font-feature-settings "ss03". Leave a 24px gap, then an h1 in Arizona Flare 50px weight 400, line-height 1.04, letter-spacing -2px, color #121715. Leave a 16px gap, then a subhead in Inter 18px weight 400, line-height 1.333, color #485450, with key nouns in #121715 weight 500. Leave a 32px gap, then the primary/secondary button pair. On the right, place a product screenshot with 12px radius and a 1px #f1f0ee border.

3. Build a telemetry strip: full-width band with 1px #0000000a top and bottom borders and 20px vertical padding, inner content constrained to 1088px. Start with the label "Agents at work today" in Inter 14px weight 500 #121715. Follow it with repeating items spaced 24px apart. Each item is a label in Inter 12px weight 500 #485450 plus a counter chip: background #1fa77a14, radius 2px, padding 4px 6px, Paper Mono 12px weight 500, letter-spacing 0.24px, color #0c8c5e, "ss03". Fade both horizontal edges to #ffffff over 48px and animate as a slow ticker.

4. Build a bento feature card: background #faf8f5, 1px solid #0000000a border, 6px radius, no shadow, 24px horizontal padding and 24px bottom padding. The upper area holds a grayscale UI illustration with skeleton bars in #f1f0ee, white sub-panels at 12px radius, and one #0c8c5e accent bar. Anchor the title at the bottom left with 32px top padding, in Inter 16px weight 500, line-height 1.5, color #121715. Arrange cards in a grid with 12px gutters: a 2/3+1/3 row, a 3-up row, then one full-width row.

5. Build a sticky navigation bar: height 64px plus a 1px #0000000a bottom border, background #ffffff, content constrained to 1088px. Put a 104×24px wordmark on the left. In the center, place Products, Solutions, Resources and Pricing in Inter 14px weight 500 #121715 with 4px 10px padding, adding 12px chevrons on the three menus. On the right, place Sign in (#fefdfb fill, 1px #0000000f border, 4px radius, 8px 14px padding, 34px height) and Contact sales (#08090a fill, #ffffff text, 4px radius, 8px 14px padding) with an 8px gap.

### Cream Button — Secondary

**Role:** Alternate path beside the primary

Paper-on-paper control. The spec is background #fefdfb, text #121715, 1px solid #0000000f border, and 4px radius. Padding is 12px 16px for a 42px height in the hero (Sign up with Google) and 8px 14px for 34px in the nav (Sign in). Type is Inter 14px weight 500 with no shadow. **Role:** Previous/next controls for testimonials

### Navigation Bar — Sticky

**Role:** Persistent top chrome and routing

The center holds Products, Solutions and Resources with 12px chevrons, plus Pricing, all in Inter 14px weight 500 #121715 with 4px 10px padding. The right side holds the Cream Sign in and the Ink Contact sales at 34px with an 8px gap. It behaves like the header of the docs product itself, which is intentional.

### Telemetry Chip — Announcement

**Role:** Live metric above the hero

Bordered label with an embedded readout. The outer chip has a #ffffff fill, a 1px solid #0000000a border, 4px radius and 4px 6px padding. Its label is Inter 12px weight 500 in #485450 with +0.24px tracking. Inside it, a counter sits on #1fa77a14 at 2px radius with 4px 6px padding, set in Paper Mono 12px 500 #0c8c5e with ss03 and a trailing 12px chevron. It replaces the conventional "New feature →" pill with a number that updates, which is punctuation rather than decoration.

### Telemetry Strip — Agents at Work

**Role:** Social-proof ticker in data form

Instrument panel band. It runs full width between two 1px #0000000a rules with 20px vertical padding. The lead label "Agents at work today" is Inter 14px weight 500 #121715. It is followed by pairs of Inter 12px #485450 labels and #1fa77a14 counter chips in Paper Mono 12px 500 #0c8c5e, spaced 24px apart, with edge fades on the ticker. Ordinary social proof shows logos. This strip shows throughput, which is the most on-thesis component on the page.

### Logo Wall Tile

**Role:** Customer logo grid cell

Recessed paper square. Each tile measures 166×161px with background #faf8f5, a 1px solid #0000000a border, 6px radius and 0 padding. It holds a monochrome logo in #121715, centered, with no shadow. Tiles run in a 4×2 grid with 8px gaps beside a 24px heading-sm column, where "20,000+" sits in #121715 against #717d79 surrounding words. The tile sinks below the white canvas instead of floating above it, so logos read as an archive rather than an advertisement.

### Bento Feature Card

**Role:** Product capability with illustration

Quiet framed panel. The spec is background #faf8f5, a 1px solid #0000000a border, 6px radius, 24px side padding and a 32px top pad on the title. The title is Inter 16px weight 500 #121715 anchored at the bottom left, with no shadow. Above it sits grayscale UI-ghost illustration with mint line art. Cards run 2/3+1/3, then three-up, then full width, all with 12px gutters. Mockup-internal elements such as the "Ask AI anything" pill (9999px) are the only place the pill radius appears, and they are allowed because they depict the product rather than the page.

### Split-Tone Section Heading

**Role:** Section opener with paired CTA

Two-ink headline. It is set in Inter 36px weight 500 at 1.111 line height with -0.72px tracking and a 664px max width. The claim sentence is #121715 and the continuation clause is #717d79. A 2px-wide, 24px-tall #0c8c5e tick sits on the left page rail, and a 42px Ink Button is right-aligned on the same baseline. Hierarchy comes from color rather than weight, which is the anti-convention core of the type system.

### Customer Story Card — Brand-Color Outlier

**Role:** Testimonial carousel slide

The system outlier. Each card is a full-bleed fill in the customer's own color (Anthropic #c44120, Coinbase #0052ff — decorative, not system tokens), paired with a photograph. The radius is 12px 12px 0 0. The wordmark is white. Stats are #ffffff in Inter 44px weight 400 at -0.88px tracking above 16px labels, with 24px padding. It breaks the one-hue budget on purpose: the colors belong to the customers, and borrowing them makes the evidence look external rather than authored.

### FAQ Accordion Row

**Role:** Expandable question list

Bare ruled row. Each row is a 768px-wide button with 20px 0 padding for a 64px height and no fill. The question is Inter 16px weight 400 #121715 with a 16px plus glyph right. A 1px #f1f0ee divider separates rows, and the answer opens in Inter 14px #485450. It uses no card and no radius, just rule lines, exactly like a documentation changelog. Use it wherever content is list-shaped rather than object-shaped.

### Floating Assistant Trigger

**Role:** Persistent AI help entry point

Docked utility tab. It is fixed 16px from the bottom-right corner, with background #fefdfb, a 1px solid #0000000f border, 4px radius and 8px 12px padding. Type is Inter 14px weight 500 #121715 beside a 16px book icon, and the shadow is `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)`. This is the one component that carries the system's only shadow token, so it reads as resting on the page without becoming a glossy chat bubble.

### Footer — Status Ledger

**Role:** Site map and system status

Ruled multi-column index. The footer spans 1905px with 104px top padding and link columns in Inter 14px weight 400 #485450 under 12px weight 500 #121715 headers. A 1px #0000000a rule caps the block. The "All systems normal" line uses an 8px dot in #16a34a (status-only, not a system token) beside Inter 14px #485450 text. It ends the page the way a docs site does: with uptime, not a slogan.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every control label, nav item and button in Inter 14px weight 500 — with 60+ uses it is the workhorse that makes the page feel like product chrome.
- Keep buttons and tags at 4px and cards at 6px — two adjacent radii separate "press" from "contain" without introducing a rounded vocabulary.
- Draw structure with 1px #0000000a hairlines, including the vertical rails on the 1088px column — translucent 4% black matches on #ffffff and #faf8f5 alike.
- Spend Arizona Flare once per page, at 50px weight 400 tracked -2px — the scarcity of the serif is what makes the hero read as authored. This rule is non-negotiable.
- Render every live number in Paper Mono 12px weight 500, +0.24px, ss03, on a #1fa77a14 chip with #0c8c5e digits — figures become instrument readings.
- Split section headings into a #121715 claim and a #717d79 continuation at 36px weight 500 — hierarchy through ink keeps the weight ceiling at 500.
- Cap heading measure at 664px and FAQ measure at 768px inside the 1088px rail — documentation line lengths are part of the voice.

### Don't

- Don't bump headings to weight 600 or 700 — this is a marketing page typeset like its own documentation, and bold display type turns the reference manual into an ad.
- Never fill a primary button with Forest Ink #0c8c5e — #08090a owns action, and a green CTA would compete with the logo and the telemetry chips.
- Don't round CTAs to 9999px — the pill radius exists only inside product mockups, and pill buttons would pull the system toward consumer-app softness.
- Don't add drop shadows to bento cards or logo tiles — the only shadow is a 2% inset ring, and a 0 8px 24px blur would float objects the system deliberately recesses.
- Don't extend Arizona Flare to the 36px section heads — two serif headlines dilute the single editorial gesture into a theme.
- Don't use #000000 for body text — #121715 carries a green undertone that keeps neutrals tied to the mint without adding a hue.
- Don't tint the page canvas to #faf8f5 — linen only reads as recessed against #ffffff, and flooding it erases the tile hierarchy.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | Page ground, nav bar, telemetry strip and FAQ background. |
| 1 | Linen Tile | `#faf8f5` | Recessed containers: logo wall tiles, bento feature cards, mockup wells. |
| 2 | Cream Surface | `#fefdfb` | Pressable controls: secondary buttons, icon squares, assistant trigger. |
| 3 | Jet Action | `#08090a` | Inverted surface reserved for primary action fills. |

## Elevation

- **Floating assistant trigger and framed panels:** `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)`
- **Cards, tiles and logo wall:** `none` with 1px `#0000000a` hairline border
- **Secondary and icon buttons:** `none` with 1px `#0000000f` border
- **Primary buttons:** `none` — the #08090a fill is the elevation

## Imagery

The page uses three image modes, and none of them is stock photography. First is the product screenshot: the hero shows a 1055×641px render of a Mintlify docs site, framed at 12px radius with a 1px #f1f0ee border on #ffffff and fading at the bottom edge. Second is schematic illustration: bento cards hold grayscale UI ghosts with tiny #0c8c5e accents and agent cursors. Third is customer photography, confined to story cards beside full-bleed brand colors. Icons are 16px single-weight line glyphs in #121715. The signature graphic is a field of fine mint-to-lime line strands sweeping through the hero and some bento cards. Those strands (#18e299 and lime, decorative, not system tokens) are illustration, not a gradient token. The narrative is agents flowing through a well-ruled knowledge base.

## Layout

Content holds to a 1088px column bounded by 1px #0000000a vertical rails, so the page reads like a ruled sheet. Sections are separated by about 104px of vertical space and by horizontal hairlines that cross the rails. The hero splits into a 352px left column (telemetry chip, 50px serif headline, 18px subhead, button pair) and a product screenshot that bleeds right past the rail over line art. Below the hero, sections alternate between ruled bands (logo wall, telemetry strip) and headed blocks (split-tone heading plus bento grid). Grids are 4×2 for logos, 2/3+1/3, 3-up and full width for bento, and a horizontal carousel for stories. The nav is sticky, 65px and white-filled, with the logo left, four menus centered and two buttons right. The footer is a multi-column index with 104px top padding. At 375px, set the display at 36px and the section gap at 48px. Density is comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- recessed tile: #faf8f5 (Linen Tile)
- primary text: #121715 (Ink)
- secondary text: #485450 (Slate Caption)
- hairline: #0000000a (Fog Hairline)
- accent tint: #1fa77a14 (Mint Wash)
- primary action: #08090a (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars use neutral fills in #121715 and #969e9b on #faf8f5. Mint appears only as a #1fa77a14 (8% opacity) tint behind values or as #0c8c5e for one highlighted series, so the accent stays at counter-chip volume.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: background #08090a, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 4px, padding 12px 12px 12px 16px, height 42px, Inter 14px weight 500, line-height 1.143, letter-spacing 0. Add a 12px right-chevron icon in #ffffff after the label with a 4px gap. Use no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and shift the chevron 2px right. Place it beside a secondary button with background #fefdfb, text #121715, a 1px solid #0000000f border, 4px radius, padding 12px 16px and the same 42px height, separated by an 8px gap.

2. Build a hero section: a #ffffff canvas with a 1088px container bounded by 1px #0000000a left and right borders. The left column is 352px wide. Stack a telemetry chip first: #ffffff fill, 1px #0000000a border, 4px radius, 4px 6px padding, label "Agent traffic" in Inter 12px weight 500 #485450 with 0.24px tracking, and a nested #1fa77a14 counter at 2px radius showing "77.3981%" in Paper Mono 12px weight 500 #0c8c5e with font-feature-settings "ss03". Leave a 24px gap, then an h1 in Arizona Flare 50px weight 400, line-height 1.04, letter-spacing -2px, color #121715. Leave a 16px gap, then a subhead in Inter 18px weight 400, line-height 1.333, color #485450, with key nouns in #121715 weight 500. Leave a 32px gap, then the primary/secondary button pair. On the right, place a product screenshot with 12px radius and a 1px #f1f0ee border.

3. Build a telemetry strip: full-width band with 1px #0000000a top and bottom borders and 20px vertical padding, inner content constrained to 1088px. Start with the label "Agents at work today" in Inter 14px weight 500 #121715. Follow it with repeating items spaced 24px apart. Each item is a label in Inter 12px weight 500 #485450 plus a counter chip: background #1fa77a14, radius 2px, padding 4px 6px, Paper Mono 12px weight 500, letter-spacing 0.24px, color #0c8c5e, "ss03". Fade both horizontal edges to #ffffff over 48px and animate as a slow ticker.

4. Build a bento feature card: background #faf8f5, 1px solid #0000000a border, 6px radius, no shadow, 24px horizontal padding and 24px bottom padding. The upper area holds a grayscale UI illustration with skeleton bars in #f1f0ee, white sub-panels at 12px radius, and one #0c8c5e accent bar. Anchor the title at the bottom left with 32px top padding, in Inter 16px weight 500, line-height 1.5, color #121715. Arrange cards in a grid with 12px gutters: a 2/3+1/3 row, a 3-up row, then one full-width row.

5. Build a sticky navigation bar: height 64px plus a 1px #0000000a bottom border, background #ffffff, content constrained to 1088px. Put a 104×24px wordmark on the left. In the center, place Products, Solutions, Resources and Pricing in Inter 14px weight 500 #121715 with 4px 10px padding, adding 12px chevrons on the three menus. On the right, place Sign in (#fefdfb fill, 1px #0000000f border, 4px radius, 8px 14px padding, 34px height) and Contact sales (#08090a fill, #ffffff text, 4px radius, 8px 14px padding) with an 8px gap.

## Docs-Grade Typesetting

The discipline is that the marketing page obeys the typographic rules of a documentation product. Labels run at 14px weight 500, headings top out at weight 500, measure is capped at 664px for headings and 768px for FAQ, and the 1088px column is literally ruled with #0000000a rails. Three changes would break it: a 72px bold hero, centered paragraphs wider than 768px, or headings at weight 700. Each one replaces the reference-manual voice with launch-page volume. To extend the system, add new sections as either ruled bands or headed blocks. Open each with a split-tone 36px heading in #121715 and #717d79, separate it with hairlines rather than background color changes, and set any new metadata in Inter 12px weight 500 at +0.24px, exactly as a docs sidebar would.

## Rationed Mint Telemetry

Mint is not a brand color applied everywhere. It is a signal reserved for live data and identity. In system tokens it appears only as #1fa77a14 behind numbers and #0c8c5e on digits, the heading tick and the logo, while the hero strands are decorative. Two moves would break this: a mint primary button, or mint section backgrounds. Either one makes green ambient, and the counters stop reading as live readings. To extend the system, give any new quantitative element (usage meters, changelog counts, status figures) the same chip: Paper Mono 12px weight 500, 2px radius, 4px 6px padding. Keep every saturated non-mint color either customer-owned, like the story cards, or status-only, like the #16a34a footer dot.

## The Single Serif

Arizona Flare is used once, at 50px with -2px tracking, in a narrow 352px column. That makes the hero headline read like the title page of a book while everything after it reads like the book's interface. The serif's authority depends on its isolation. Setting it on the 36px section heads, using it for testimonial quotes, or loosening its tracking to 0 would each turn a deliberate gesture into a theme. To extend the system to new pages, give each page at most one Arizona Flare headline at 50px. On phones, step it down to 36px with -0.72px tracking, and let Inter 36px weight 500 carry every other heading.

## Similar Brands

- **Vercel** — shares black 4–6px action buttons on white with translucent hairline borders, but sets headlines heavier in Geist and has no serif counterweight.
- **GitBook** — a direct documentation-platform competitor that also markets with docs-style product renders, but leans on colored gradients where Mintlify rations a single mint tint.
- **Resend** — pairs a serif display headline with a sans UI for a developer audience, but on a near-black canvas rather than ruled white paper.
- **Supabase** — uses green as its single brand hue on a developer product, but floods dark surfaces with it where Mintlify holds green to 8% tints and 12px digits.
- **Linear** — shares weight-500 headings with negative tracking and hairline-only structure, but runs dark with gradient lighting instead of warm-white tiles.
